description:
[Politically exposed persons tiered risk engine & 12-month cooling-off auditor. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits PEP status under Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 Article 28 across 5 tiers, evaluating the statutory 12-month post-office cooling-off period and senior management approval requirements.
Usage: Use this tool to verify PEP status, calculate elapsed time since leaving public office, and determine mandatory source of wealth audits.
Returns: JSON object with { personFullName: string, isPepActive: boolean, pepCategoryTier: string, coolingOffPeriodStatus: object, mandatoryComplianceObligations: object }.

countryOfPublicFunctionIso2.description: Country where the public office was exercised

dateLeftOfficeIso.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when public office was vacated

holdsBeneficialOwnershipOver25Percent.description: Whether PEP holds >= 25% shareholding in client company

isCurrentlyInOffice.description: Whether the person currently occupies the position

personFullName.description: Full legal name of the individual

relationshipDescription.description: Nature of family tie or business partnership for Tier 4/5 PEPs

roleCategory.description: Categorization of the prominent public function ex 6AMLD Article 24

name: pep_tiered_risk_assessor
